economics.labels: cumulative_economic_loss_usd and max_drawdown_usd are the ONLY two fields the cohort stops read, and both are computed over SETTLED windows only. A profitable window carries a NEGATIVE loss and reduces it. Pending windows contribute nothing -- their risk lives in the per-market gates. Unrecoverable windows contribute nothing and are never estimated from turnover. REALIZED stays null until attributable cash is read back.

fee_provenance.note: an execution with no `n` contributes nothing and is COUNTED here: absent is unknown, never zero

fill_provenance.note: VERIFIED, not assumed from post-only. An execution with no `m` is UNKNOWN and is never counted as maker.

economics.rebates_note: CREDITED rebates only. None read back means None, not zero: an assumed rebate is exactly the kind of number that makes a bad trade look profitable.
economics.realized_note: REALIZED requires an attributable cash movement read back from the account. Nothing here is it.
economics.why: the contract has not settled, so its payout is UNKNOWN and is not guessed. It contributes NOTHING to cohort economic loss; its risk is bounded by the per-market committed, residual and exposure gates inside the driver.

inventory.labels: gross_fill_spend_usd is cash OUT from confirmed fills. It is TURNOVER, never a loss.

labels: OBSERVABILITY ONLY. Written after each decision and after each mutation returns; it cannot sit between a decision and its order, makes no venue read of its own, and changes no timing. settlement_implied_net_usd is IMPLIED and null until the venue publishes a resolution; nothing here is REALIZED, which requires an attributable cash movement.
